- '3.11'

about.description:
DateTime provides the date and time type that Zope and Plone use. It
parses a wide range of date strings, carries a timezone, and supports
arithmetic and comparison against other DateTime values. Unless you need
to talk to Zope APIs you are probably better off with Python's built-in
datetime module.
about.summary: A DateTime data type, as known from Zope

tests.script: python -c "from DateTime import DateTime; d = DateTime('2026-01-02 03:04:05 UTC'); assert d.year() == 2026 and d.month() == 1 and d.day() == 2, d"

name: datetime
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "6.0"

package:
  name: datetime
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/d/datetime/datetime-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c1514936d2f901e10c8e08d83bf04e6c9dbd7ca4f244da94fec980980a3bc4d5

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=78.1.1,<81
    - wheel
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - zope.interface
    - pytz

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - DateTime
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - python -c "from DateTime import DateTime; d = DateTime('2026-01-02 03:04:05 UTC'); assert d.year() == 2026 and d.month() == 1 and d.day() == 2, d"
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/zopefoundation/DateTime
  repository: https://github.com/zopefoundation/DateTime
  license: ZPL-2.1
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - COPYRIGHT.txt
  summary: A DateTime data type, as known from Zope
  description: |
    DateTime provides the date and time type that Zope and Plone use. It
    parses a wide range of date strings, carries a timezone, and supports
    arithmetic and comparison against other DateTime values. Unless you need
    to talk to Zope APIs you are probably better off with Python's built-in
    datetime module.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - killua156
